CLAIMS_TABLE = "delegate_skill_command_claims"


def claims_schema() -> str:
    """The schema the node contract declares for the claim table."""
    from pathlib import Path

    import yaml

    contract_path = (
        Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1] / "contract.yaml"
    )
    contract = yaml.safe_load(contract_path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    entries = [
        entry
        for entry in contract["db_io"]["db_tables"]
        if entry["name"] == CLAIMS_TABLE
    ]
    if len(entries) != 1:
        raise ValueError(f"expected exactly one contract entry for {CLAIMS_TABLE!r}, got {entries}")
    return str(entries[0]["schema"])
